'''Vigrat Pomoner''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Iotran/Legends|Iotran]] from the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Iotra]], where he served as a member of the [[Iotran Police Force]]. Joining the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] after the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]] sent him and other [[Police officer/Legends|members]] of Iotra's [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police force]] into an [[Unidentified ambush|ambush]], Pomoner was the [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]] for the [[Snowspeeder/Legends|snowspeeder]] designated [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue]] [[Rogue Six/Legends|Six]] during the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], when [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] forces attacked the Rebels [[Hoth/Legends|there]]. He was [[Death/Legends|killed]] when an Imperial [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transport]] shot down his [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]].

==Biography==
[[File:Rogue_Group_TESB_Manga.jpg|250px|thumb|The twelve airspeeders of Rogue Group, including gunner Pomoner, attack during the Battle of Hoth.]]
A [[Gender/Legends|male]]<ref name="Warfare" /> of the militaristic<ref name="Role">[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game, Second Edition|''Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game'', Second Edition]]</ref> [[Iotran/Legends|Iotran]] [[Species/Legends|species]], Vigrat Pomoner hailed from the<ref name="Warfare" /> [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]<ref name="Atlas">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Iotra]], and was part of the [[Iotran Police Force]]. After a unit of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Imperial Military/Legends|military]] sent him and other [[Police officer/Legends|members]] of the [[Law enforcement agency/Legends|police force]] into an [[Unidentified ambush|ambush]] because [[Non-huMan]] lives were considered expendable to them, Pomoner joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] as the Rebels tried to [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|overthrow]] the Empire. He was part of the Rebel-controlled [[Echo Base/Legends|Echo Base's]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] complement that composed [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Flight]], [[Blue Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Blue Squadron]], and [[Green Squadron (Rebel Alliance)/Legends|Green Squadron]] on the barren [[Water/Legends|ice]] planet [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. When Echo Base was discovered by an Imperial [[Viper probe droid/Legends|Viper probe droid]] in [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], the Imperial unit [[Death Squadron/Legends|Death Squadron]], led by the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|attacked]] the Rebels there.<ref name="Warfare" />

Pomoner was one of the many Rebel pilots from the starfighter complement who were scrambled together to create Rogue Group. The only non-[[Human/Legends|Human]] in Rogue Group, Pomoner was assigned to a [[Snowspeeder/Legends|snowspeeder]] designated as [[Rogue Six/Legends|Rogue Six]] to be its [[Gunner/Legends|gunner]], and flew with pilot [[Samoc Farr/Legends|Samoc Farr]] as Rogue Group attempted to buy [[Time/Legends|time]] for the Rebel personnel to evacuate Echo Base aboard [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|GR-75 medium transports]]. In the battle, an Imperial [[All Terrain Armored Transport/Legends|All Terrain Armored Transport]] [[Walker/Legends|walker]] shot down Pomoner's T-47, [[Death/Legends|killing]] him, though Farr survived.<ref name="Warfare" />

==Personality and traits==
A hulking Iotran, Pomoner joined the Alliance because he was opposed to the way Imperial forces sent his police force into an ambush, as the Imperials considered [[Alien/Legends|non-Human]] lives expendable.<ref name="Warfare" />

==Behind the scenes==
Vigrat Pomoner's T-47 first appeared in [[Star Wars Manga: The Empire Strikes Back 1|''Star Wars Manga: The Empire Strikes Back'' 1]], a manga installment released by [[Dark Horse Comics]]<ref name="Manga">[[Star Wars Manga: The Empire Strikes Back 1|''Star Wars Manga: The Empire Strikes Back'' 1]]</ref> on [[January 27]], [[1999]].<ref name="Marvel">{{Marvel|url=comics/issue/54604/star_wars_the_empire_strikes_back_manga_1999_1|text=Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back Manga (1999) #1}}</ref> The manga served as an adaption of [[1980]] [[original trilogy]] film [[Star Wars: Episode V The Empire Strikes Back|''Star Wars'': Episode V ''The Empire Strikes Back'']].<ref name="Manga" /> Vigrat Pomoner was first identified as the T-47's gunner in ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]'', an extensive [[Star Wars: Essential Guides|guide]] dedicated to the conflicts in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], written by [[Jason Fry]] and [[Paul R. Urquhart]] and released in [[2012]].<ref name="Warfare" />
